n1.speaker: maya
n1.text: Tickets, please! Oh, it's you again. My favourite passenger. You've got a tan! Have you been away?

translations.fa: بلیت‌ها لطفاً! اوه، باز تویی. مسافر محبوبم. برنزه شدی! جایی رفته بودی؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, I went to Cornwall for a week.
Hello, Maya! Yes, I was on holiday.

n2.speaker: maya
n2.text: Cornwall! Lucky you. Where did you stay? Please say a little cottage by the sea.

translations.fa: کورنوال! خوش به حالت. کجا موندی؟ لطفاً بگو یه کلبهٔ کوچیک کنار دریا.

branches.suggestion: We stayed in a little cottage in St Ives.
branches.suggestionFa: تو یه کلبهٔ کوچیک تو سنت آیوز موندیم.

branches.suggestion: I stayed in a youth hostel. It was cheap.
branches.suggestionFa: تو یه مسافرخونهٔ جوانان موندم. ارزون بود.

cultureNote.en: Past simple for finished holidays: we went, we stayed, it was. Many verbs are irregular: go → went, eat → ate, swim → swam.
cultureNote.fa: برای تعطیلات تمام‌شده از گذشتهٔ ساده استفاده کنید؛ بسیاری از فعل‌ها بی‌قاعده‌اند.

match: we were stay in a cottage
recasts.echo: You stayed in a cottage? Lovely!
recasts.better: We stayed in a little cottage.

n3.speaker: maya
n3.text: St Ives! I went there as a kid. Did you go on the train? It's the most beautiful line in the country.

translations.fa: سنت آیوز! بچه که بودم رفتم. با قطار رفتی؟ قشنگ‌ترین خط کشوره.

branches.suggestion: Yes! The train went along the sea. Amazing.
branches.suggestionFa: آره! قطار کنار دریا رفت. معرکه بود.

branches.suggestion: No, we drove. It took seven hours!
branches.suggestionFa: نه، با ماشین رفتیم. هفت ساعت طول کشید!

n4.speaker: maya
n4.text: Seven hours! The A30 in August — a nightmare. And what was the weather like? Be honest. It's Cornwall.

translations.fa: هفت ساعت! جادهٔ A30 تو اوت — کابوس. و هوا چطور بود؟ صادق باش. کورنواله.

branches.suggestion: It was sunny for three days, then it rained.
branches.suggestionFa: سه روز آفتابی بود، بعد بارون اومد.

branches.suggestion: It was windy every day! My hat flew away.
branches.suggestionFa: هر روز باد میومد! کلاهم پرید.

n5.speaker: maya
n5.text: Ha! Classic. And what did you do? Did you swim in the sea? It's freezing, even in summer.

translations.fa: ها! معمولیه. و چی کار کردی؟ تو دریا شنا کردی؟ حتی تابستون هم یخه.

branches.suggestion: I swam once. Only for two minutes!
branches.suggestionFa: یه بار شنا کردم. فقط دو دقیقه!

branches.suggestion: No, I didn't. It was too cold. I walked on the beach.
branches.suggestionFa: نه، نکردم. خیلی سرد بود. ساحل قدم زدم.

n6.speaker: maya
n6.text: Two minutes! You're braver than me. Did you eat a proper Cornish pasty? That's the law down there.

translations.fa: دو دقیقه! از من شجاع‌تری. یه پیراشکی کورنیشی درست‌حسابی خوردی؟ اونجا قانونه.

branches.suggestion: Yes, I ate three. They were delicious!
branches.suggestionFa: آره، سه تا خوردم. خوشمزه بودن!

cultureNote.en: A Cornish pasty is a pastry filled with beef, potato, swede and onion. It was a lunch for tin miners in Cornwall.
cultureNote.fa: پیراشکی کورنیشی خمیری پر از گوشت، سیب‌زمینی و پیاز است؛ ناهار معدنچیان کورنوال بود.

n7.speaker: maya
n7.text: Three pasties! Proper holiday. So — best moment? Everybody has one.

translations.fa: سه تا پیراشکی! تعطیلات واقعی. خب — بهترین لحظه؟ همه یکی دارن.

branches.suggestion: I saw seals near the harbour!
The sunset on the last night. It was beautiful.
branches.suggestionFa: غروب آخرین شب. خیلی قشنگ بود.

n8.speaker: maya
n8.text: Seals and sunsets. Perfect. Right, I need your ticket really. Ah — you've got a railcard now. Good lad!

translations.fa: فک و غروب. عالی. خب، واقعاً بلیتت را لازم دارم. آه — الان کارت تخفیف قطار داری. آفرین!

branches.suggestion: Yes! You told me about it last time.
branches.suggestionFa: آره! دفعهٔ قبل تو بهم گفتی.

branches.suggestion: It saved me thirty pounds on the Cornwall trip.
branches.suggestionFa: تو سفر کورنوال سی پوند برام صرفه‌جویی کرد.

n9.speaker: maya
n9.text: Thirty quid! See, always listen to Maya. Enjoy your day — and send me a postcard next time!

translations.fa: سی پوند! دیدی، همیشه به حرف مایا گوش کن. روز خوبی داشته باشی — و دفعهٔ بعد برام کارت‌پستال بفرست!
